answer: An hostile operator running 183 aliases therefore needs 12 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in lantern, expire in horizon, and beacon lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 79 dollars in locked collateral and another 1 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
